scope: Spirit healer corpse-graveyard transfers between continent maps, pending/logout/ACK and component recovery
finding: No new production defect found in the completed cross-continent paths. This commit adds regression coverage, supports ordinary non-zoned continent maps in the fixture map-placement helper and extends Release evidence checks. No production C++ or SQL migration is changed by this commit.

Both transfer directions and both faction anchors are tested.

Pending logout uses instance0; completed map1220 arrival uses worker7541 and completed map0/1 uses instance0. Every ACK path also repeats ACK without changing health/map/corpse.

Thirty-two actual-logout cases construct a fresh same-GUID socketless Player, restore saved health/flags, invoke native prepared aura/effect loaders and LoadCorpse, then attach the native map selection at the independently verified saved destination. They retain alive/health321, sickness15007, no ghost/corpse and exact destination. Old-session ACK/spirit requests before and after fresh Player construction cannot recreate or mutate it.

Existing24 cross-zone spirit transfers/16 reload components,88 graveyard/logout cases,40 ghost returns,32 older ghost reload components and configured Helya control regressions also pass. Native DBErrors is empty and Server.log contains no ERROR. Earned raid encounter mask remains unchanged by spirit cases. Scratch schema-only auth/character databases and SQL users are removed.

Extended Test-SpiritGraveyardRelease.ps1 requires all48 far cases/32 reload components, matches canonical source/library/executable hashes and retains the native SaveToDB near-or-far zone gate, far live-save deferral/logout and other configured Release checks.

Canonical Release worldserver/bnetserver targets were rebuilt through their original final-link libraries in build-extractors/bin/Release. Existing stale MAP provenance was corrected by configuring local CMAKE_EXE_LINKER_FLAGS_RELEASE=/MAP and relinking; current executable/MAP were generated together and the previously failing Rockaway Release check then passed.

Server.log has no ERROR entries. This is retained as a separate Darkheart limitation, not counted as an error-free startup. No server was running when rebuild began, and no background server remains at handoff.

Completing the canonical Release targets restored library/executable consistency without bypassing freshness checks.

The baseline now drains those prior writes, asserts source map identity, then compares the new deferred request. No production save change was made.

The initial native snapshot also stopped before the normal forced zone update; it is not final worker-selection evidence.

workspace_context: Pre-existing concurrent DarkHeartThicket script/research/test/SQL changes were present at entry and are preserved outside this commit. Completing the canonical build consumed the current workspace scripts library; these Spirit/Trial tests and startup do not constitute validation or approval of the unrelated Darkheart work.
limits: Socketless Players, fixture-spawned native healer6491, component ghost placement and decoded handler calls are used. No authenticated client connection or network opcode-routing/timing claim is made.

Fresh-Player checks restore selected SQL health/flags and actual prepared aura/LoadCorpse components and attach at the verified destination. They do not call aggregate Player::LoadFromDB, simulate offline duration, restore full inventory/pets or prove cold-server character recovery.

The next-update zone action is invoked through native UpdateZone and its actual session callback without ticking unrelated health regeneration. Fully concurrent map workers, client renderer/collision readiness, movement release and visible zone transition remain client/runtime checks.

Missing client ACK followed by logout, duplicate ACK and stale old-session requests are covered. A destination admission rejection, live connection timeout/retry or disabled destination was not injected in these open-world map transfers; prior raid rejection audits retain their separate scope.
Spirit dialog, sickness display, durability UI, corpse/bones appearance, camera/pet portrait and actual travel in the7.3.5 client remain pending verification.
next_candidate: Spirit healer destination refusal or interrupted live connection and the resulting recovery path, without changing successful open-world resurrection.
